about: Untagged enums with text arms and one structured arm. A case fills a root type from its layers in order (a JSON document read by a hand-written source, or environment variables with the prefix APP) and expects the built value, the keys still missing, or an error whose message holds the text given. Cached holds a CacheSetting (Enabled(bool) | Tuned(CacheOptions), default Enabled(true)); Vetted holds a Switch (On | Off | Custom(Definition), lowercase names, required).
